fields.gap: Lift at the site: dL/L = dp/p - dT/T. A QUESTIONABLE hot summer afternoon at +25.1 K takes the margin to -186.3 kg; 0.1 mm of retained water is 125.6 kg, 51 percent of the margin; 1 mm is 1257 kg. No site is named anywhere in the mainline, so the 5 percent margin has no climate envelope.
fields.direction: Name the operating site and season windows; size a ballast or trim system for the hot-day deficit; require a hydrophobic coating and a shedding check before flight; weigh the hull after rain.
fields.effect: Margin negative at the hot extreme without these; climbing does not recover it (lift falls about 9.4 percent per km).
